result.brief: 结合3D高斯泼溅与可微MPM仿真从视觉演示中估计物体物理参数，并以此条件化材料感知MoE扩散策略，实现跨材质自适应操作。
result.reason: Recovers material properties via 3D Gaussian Splatting plus differentiable MPM simulation and conditions a diffusion policy; main contribution is robot manipulation policy, matching the secondary world-model application direction.
